title: Habits, Routines & Broken Patterns
goal: Combine soler, dejar de and aspectual se to describe everyday habits and changed routines
grammar: soler (present/imperfect only) and dejar de / no dejar de + infinitive

items: I can layer *soler* with aspectual *se* while avoiding invalid tenses and redundancy.
I can use *dejar de* for stopped habits and *no dejar de* for persistence or emphasis.
I can use everyday habit vocabulary like *al pie de la letra*, *de corrido*, *improvisar* and *el apuro*.
